title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Harvard's celebrated introduction to computer science, from algorithms and data structures to web development, with a free CS50 certificate.
longDescription: CS50x is Harvard University's introduction to the intellectual enterprises of computer science and the art of programming. The course starts with Scratch and moves through C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Lectures, shorts, problem sets, and a final project are available online at no cost. You can take the course entirely for free; an optional verified certificate from edX costs money.
license: Free to audit · optional paid verified certificate
author: David J. Malan

title: Responsive Web Design Certification
description: Learn HTML, CSS, flexbox, grid, accessibility, and responsive design by building real projects — completely free.
longDescription: This self-paced certification covers the foundations of modern web design. You will build a survey form, a tribute page, a product landing page, technical documentation, and a personal portfolio. freeCodeCamp is a donor-supported nonprofit: every course and certification is free, with no paywall or upsell.

title: Khan Academy
description: Free, world-class practice in maths, science, computing, economics, and more — from primary school to university foundations.
longDescription: Khan Academy offers thousands of lessons, practice exercises, and instructional videos across maths, science, computing, economics, history, and test preparation. The platform is free for learners and teachers, supported by philanthropy. Bangla-language content is available for selected subjects, alongside English and other regional languages.

title: NPTEL Online Courses
description: Hundreds of rigorous engineering, science, and management courses from India's top institutes, with free video lectures and notes.
longDescription: NPTEL is a joint initiative of the Indian Institutes of Technology and the Indian Institute of Science. It publishes semester-length courses in engineering, science, humanities, and management with video lectures, assignments, and reading material. Learning is free. Learners may optionally pay for a proctored exam and certificate.
license: Free to learn · optional exam fee

title: OpenLearn
description: Free short courses and articles from The Open University across technology, business, health, education, and the humanities.
longDescription: OpenLearn publishes free educational resources from The Open University, ranging from one-hour articles to multi-week courses. Topics include digital skills, business, health, science, and language learning. Most courses offer a free statement of participation; formal credit requires separate enrolment.

title: Saylor Academy
description: Free, self-paced university-level courses with optional low-cost credit pathways and open courseware.
longDescription: Saylor Academy is a nonprofit offering free online courses at college level, including computer science, business, economics, and communication. Course materials are openly licensed, and learners can choose to take paid proctored exams for credit transfer through partner institutions.

title: DigiSkills Training Program
description: Pakistan's national free digital-skills programme, covering freelancing, digital marketing, graphic design, e-commerce, and more.
longDescription: DigiSkills is a national initiative supported by Ignite and the Ministry of IT & Telecom in Pakistan. It offers free, cohort-based online training in freelancing, digital marketing, graphic design, search engine optimisation, e-commerce, and creative writing. Registration is free and courses are delivered in English and Urdu.

title: SWAYAM
description: India's national MOOC platform, offering free courses from school to postgraduate level with optional proctored certification.
longDescription: SWAYAM hosts courses produced by Indian universities and government institutions across school education, vocational skills, and higher education. All course content is free to access. Optional proctored exams and certificates are offered for a fee through the National Testing Agency.
license: Free to learn · optional exam fee

title: Learning How to Learn
provider: Coursera · McMaster University & UC San Diego
description: A practical, evidence-based course on how memory works, how to beat procrastination, and how to learn more effectively.
longDescription: One of the most popular online courses in the world, Learning How to Learn teaches techniques for mastering difficult subjects. It covers focused and diffuse thinking, chunking, memory, procrastination, and test preparation. You can audit the course for free; a shareable certificate is optional and paid.
license: Free to audit · optional paid certificate
author: Barbara Oakley & Terrence Sejnowski

title: MIT OpenCourseWare
description: Free lecture notes, exams, and videos from thousands of MIT courses, openly licensed for learners and educators.
longDescription: MIT OpenCourseWare publishes materials from thousands of MIT courses, including lecture notes, problem sets, exams, and video lectures. Materials are available under open Creative Commons licences unless otherwise noted. It is a reference library rather than an enrolled programme, so there are no certificates or credit.

title: Essence of Linear Algebra
description: A visual, intuition-first video series on vectors, matrices, determinants, and eigenvectors — free on YouTube.
longDescription: Grant Sanderson's animated series explains linear algebra geometrically rather than through rote calculation. It is an excellent companion to a university linear algebra course or a refresher before machine learning. The full series is free to watch on YouTube; supporting notes and exercises are available on the 3Blue1Brown website.
author: Grant Sanderson

title: Google Skillshop
description: Free official training and certifications for Google Ads, Analytics, Digital Marketing, and Google Workspace tools.
longDescription: Skillshop is Google's official learning platform. It offers self-paced courses and certification exams for digital marketing, advertising, analytics, and productivity tools. Courses and most certification exams are free; you need a Google account to track progress.

title: Project Gutenberg
description: Over 70,000 free eBooks, mostly public-domain literature, available in EPUB, Kindle, HTML, and plain text.
longDescription: Project Gutenberg is the oldest digital library. It offers free access to tens of thousands of books whose US copyright has expired, including classics of literature, philosophy, science, and history. Books can be read online or downloaded without an account. Copyright status can differ in your country, so check the local rules before reuse.
license: Public domain in the United States · check local law

title: OpenStax Textbooks
description: Peer-reviewed, openly licensed university textbooks in maths, science, economics, and more — free to read and download.
longDescription: OpenStax publishes high-quality, peer-reviewed textbooks that are free for students and instructors. Titles cover calculus, physics, chemistry, biology, economics, psychology, and business. Most books are licensed under Creative Commons, allowing free use and adaptation with attribution.

title: NCTB Textbooks (Bangladesh)
description: Official free textbooks for Bangladeshi students from primary through secondary level, published by NCTB.
longDescription: The National Curriculum and Textbook Board publishes the official primary and secondary school textbooks of Bangladesh. Digital editions are made available by the Government of Bangladesh for free access. This entry links directly to NCTB's website, where current editions and class-wise textbook information are published.

title: NCERT Textbooks (India)
description: Official NCERT school textbooks for classes I–XII, available chapter-wise as free PDFs in English, Hindi, and Urdu.
longDescription: The National Council of Educational Research and Training publishes official school textbooks for the Indian curriculum. The NCERT textbook portal provides class-wise, chapter-wise PDFs free of charge in English, Hindi, and Urdu. These editions are government-published educational materials and are intended for free educational use.

title: Think Python, 2nd Edition
provider: Allen B. Downey · Green Tea Press
description: A clear, beginner-friendly introduction to Python programming, free to read online with the author's permission.
longDescription: Think Python teaches programming fundamentals using Python 3. It proceeds from basic variables and functions through recursion, data structures, object-oriented programming, and debugging. The full text is available free online with the author's permission, and paperback editions can be purchased from booksellers.
author: Allen B. Downey

title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
description: A practical beginner's guide to using Python for everyday automation, free to read online under a Creative Commons licence.
longDescription: Al Sweigart's popular book teaches Python through practical tasks: renaming files, scraping websites, working with spreadsheets, sending emails, and automating repetitive work. The complete text is free to read online under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Printed and eBook editions are sold separately.
author: Al Sweigart

title: OpenIntro Statistics
description: A free, openly licensed introductory statistics textbook used by universities around the world.
longDescription: OpenIntro Statistics covers data visualisation, probability, inference, regression, and foundations of statistics. The book is written for introductory university courses and is distributed under a Creative Commons licence, with low-cost print copies available. It is a practical alternative to expensive commercial statistics texts.
license: Creative Commons · see source for version
author: David Diez, Mine Çetinkaya-Rundel & Christopher Barr

title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
description: A free PDF covering the linear algebra, calculus, probability, and optimisation needed to understand machine learning.
longDescription: Mathematics for Machine Learning bridges the gap between mathematical foundations and machine learning methods. It covers linear algebra, analytic geometry, matrix decompositions, vector calculus, probability, and optimisation. The authors provide a free PDF under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, alongside paid print and eBook editions.
author: Marc Peter Deisenroth, A. Aldo Faisal & Cheng Soon Ong

title: Deep Learning
description: The 'Deep Learning' textbook by Goodfellow, Bengio, and Courville, available to read online through the publisher.
longDescription: Deep Learning provides a comprehensive study of deep learning theory and practice, from linear algebra and probability to convolutional networks, recurrent networks, and research frontiers. The authors and MIT Press make the online edition freely accessible; print editions are sold by booksellers. No download mirror is hosted by OpenLearn Hub.
author: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio & Aaron Courville

title: The Elements of Statistical Learning
description: A classic graduate-level text on statistical learning, made available as a free PDF by its authors.
longDescription: The Elements of Statistical Learning covers supervised learning, model assessment, additive models, support vector machines, ensemble methods, and unsupervised learning. The authors provide the full PDF free of charge for personal study; the print edition is published by Springer. OpenLearn Hub links only to the authors' official page.
license: Free PDF provided by the authors
author: Trevor Hastie, Robert Tibshirani & Jerome Friedman

title: Standard Ebooks
description: Beautifully formatted, carefully edited editions of public-domain literature, free to download and reuse.
longDescription: Standard Ebooks takes public-domain works and produces modern, professionally typeset editions in EPUB, Azw3, and Kepub formats. The volunteer project adds covers, metadata, and careful proofreading. All ebook files are released into the public domain, while the project's own editorial content is available under CC0.

title: GIMP
description: A powerful, free and open-source image editor for photo retouching, image composition, and graphic design.
longDescription: GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program) is a cross-platform raster graphics editor used for photo editing, illustration, and design. It supports layers, masks, plug-ins, and advanced colour workflows. Download installers and source code only from the official GIMP website listed here.

title: Blender
description: Free and open-source 3D creation suite for modelling, animation, VFX, rendering, and video editing.
longDescription: Blender is a complete 3D production suite, covering modelling, sculpting, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering, compositing, and video editing. It is developed by the Blender Foundation and released as free software under the GNU GPL. Always download Blender from blender.org.

title: LibreOffice
description: A complete, free office suite with word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, and database tools.
longDescription: LibreOffice is a powerful office productivity suite compatible with common document formats. It includes Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base, and Math. The suite is free software under the Mozilla Public License and is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Use the official download page to avoid modified installers.

title: Visual Studio Code
description: A free, open-source code editor with debugging, Git integration, and a huge extension ecosystem.
longDescription: Visual Studio Code is a lightweight but powerful source-code editor available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It supports debugging, syntax highlighting, intelligent code completion, refactoring, and integrated Git. The source code is open under the MIT licence, while the Microsoft-branded builds are distributed free of charge.

title: OBS Studio
description: Free and open-source software for live streaming and screen recording, used by creators and educators worldwide.
longDescription: OBS Studio provides high-performance real-time video and audio capturing and mixing. It supports scenes, sources, transitions, filters, and streaming to major platforms. OBS is free software under the GPL-2.0 licence and is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Download only from obsproject.com.

title: Inkscape
description: A professional-quality vector graphics editor for illustrations, icons, logos, and diagrams.
longDescription: Inkscape is a free and open-source vector graphics editor with tools for drawing, path editing, text, gradients, and SVG export. It is widely used for logos, icons, diagrams, and print-ready art. The project is community-driven and released under the GPL.

title: Krita
description: A free, open-source digital painting studio built for illustrators, concept artists, and comics.
longDescription: Krita is a professional digital painting application with a customisable brush engine, stabilisers, wrap-around mode, animation tools, and comic-panel templates. It is free software under the GPL and is supported by the Krita Foundation.

title: Audacity
description: A free, open-source multi-track audio editor and recorder for podcasts, music, and voice work.
longDescription: Audacity records and edits audio across multiple tracks. It offers noise reduction, effects, spectrograms, and support for common audio formats. The application is free software under the GPL and is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

title: Python
description: The official Python programming language distribution for Windows, macOS, and Linux, free and open source.
longDescription: Python is a widely used, beginner-friendly programming language with a vast ecosystem for web development, data science, automation, and AI. Official installers are published by the Python Software Foundation. This listing links only to python.org/downloads, never to a third-party installer bundle.

title: Node.js
description: A free, open-source JavaScript runtime for building fast, scalable network applications and APIs.
longDescription: Node.js runs JavaScript outside the browser using the V8 engine. It is widely used for web servers, APIs, command-line tools, and build systems. Download the current LTS or current release from the official Node.js website. OpenLearn Hub does not host or mirror installers.

title: Git
description: The distributed version-control system used by developers everywhere, free and open source.
longDescription: Git tracks changes in source code and enables collaboration through branches, merges, and distributed history. It is the foundation of most modern software workflows. Official downloads for Windows, macOS, and Linux are available from git-scm.com.

title: VLC Media Player
description: A free, open-source media player that handles almost every audio and video format, on every major platform.
longDescription: VLC is a highly portable multimedia player, streamer, and converter. It plays most codecs without additional packs, supports subtitles, and can stream network media. VLC is free software under the GPL, maintained by VideoLAN.
